query: Can you sweep all our POS machines and tell me which ones need attention? Host list is in C:\ops\pos-hosts.txt.
expected_behavior: Runs Invoke-PosFleetHealth.ps1 with -ServerListFile and -OutFile (credential prompted, never on the command line)
Leads with summary.warnings grouped by type and machine - not 100 per-host reports
Reports unreachable/auth-failed hosts explicitly as possible incidents, never implying full coverage

query: Is any POS offline database getting close to the SQL Express limit?
expected_behavior: Runs the sweep and reads express_db_near_limit warnings (databases at >=80% of the 10 GB data limit)
Explains the consequence: at the cap the offline database stops accepting writes and the till stops syncing
Recommends checking the sync chain to the channel DB before shrinking anything

query: POS042 is acting up - the cashier says it's slow and sometimes freezes.
expected_behavior: Sweeps just that host (-ComputerName POS042) and reads services, disk, SQL and error counts
Correlates stopped auto-start services with recent_errors.top_providers
Routes deeper follow-up correctly: win-eventlog-triage for event detail, sqlserver-perf-triage for the local SQL instance
